name: addChar
description: Add a character definition to the select screen.
parameters: 1: defpath: string: Path to the character .def file (relative to chars/ or absolute).; 2: params: string: Optional. Optional comma-separated parameter string (from select.def)
returns: Name: Type: Description; success: boolean: true if the character was added successfully, false otherwise.

name: addHotkey
signature: addHotkey(key, ctrl, alt, shift, allowDuringPause, debugOnly, script)
description: Register a global keyboard shortcut that runs Lua code.
parameters: 1: key: string: Key name as used by the engine (for example "F1", "C", etc.).; 2: ctrl: boolean: Optional. Default: false. If true, the Ctrl key must be held.; 3: alt: boolean: Optional. Default: false. If true, the Alt key must be held.; 4: shift: boolean: Optional. Default: false. If true, the Shift key must be held.; 5: allowDuringPause: boolean: Optional. Default: false. If true, the hotkey also works while the game is paused.; 6: debugOnly: boolean: Optional. Default: false. If true, the hotkey is treated as a debug key and only works when debug input is allowed.; 7: script: string: Lua code to execute when the shortcut is pressed.
returns: Name: Type: Description; success: boolean: true if the shortcut was registered, false if the key name is invalid.

name: addStage
description: Add a stage definition to the select screen.
parameters: 1: defpath: string: Path to the stage .def file (relative to stages/ or absolute).; 2: params: string: Optional. Optional comma-separated parameter string (from select.def)
returns: Name: Type: Description; success: boolean: true if the stage was added successfully, false otherwise.

name: animAddPos
description: Add an offset to an animation's current position.
parameters: 1: anim: Anim: Animation userdata.; 2: dx: float32: Offset to add on the X axis.; 3: dy: float32: Offset to add on the Y axis.

name: animApplyVel
description: Copy velocity parameters from one animation to another.
parameters: 1: target: Anim: Target animation userdata to modify.; 2: source: Anim: Source animation userdata whose velocity/accel settings are copied.

name: animCopy
description: Create a copy of an animation.
parameters: 1: anim: Anim: Animation userdata.
returns: Name: Type: Description; copy: Anim\: nil: New Anim userdata containing a copy of anim, or nil if anim is nil.

name: animDebug
description: Print debug information about an animation to the console.
parameters: 1: anim: Anim: Animation userdata.; 2: prefix: string: Optional. Optional text prefix printed before the debug info.

name: animDraw
description: Queue drawing of an animation on a render layer.
parameters: 1: anim: Anim: Animation userdata.; 2: layer: int16: Optional. Render layer index; if omitted, the animation's own layerno is used.

name: animGetLength
description: Get timing information for an animation.
parameters: 1: anim: Anim: Animation userdata.
returns: Name: Type: Description; length: int32: Effective animation length in ticks (as returned by Anim.GetLength()).; totaltime: int32: Raw totaltime field from the underlying Animation.

name: animGetPreloadedCharData
description: Get a preloaded character animation by sprite group/number.
parameters: 1: charRef: int: 0-based character index in the select list.; 2: group: int32: Sprite group number.; 3: number: int32: Sprite number.; 4: keepLoop: boolean: Optional. Default: true. If true, keep the original loop timing. If false and the animation's totaltime equals looptime, convert it to an infinite loop (totaltime = -1, looptime = 0).
returns: Name: Type: Description; anim: Anim\: nil: A new Anim userdata wrapping the preloaded animation, or nil if no matching animation exists.

name: animGetPreloadedStageData
description: Get a preloaded stage animation by sprite group/number.
parameters: 1: stageRef: int: Stage reference used by the select system. Positive values are 1-based stage slots. 0 is the random-stage sentinel.; 2: group: int32: Sprite group number.; 3: number: int32: Sprite number.; 4: keepLoop: boolean: Optional. Default: true. If true, keep the original loop timing. If false and the animation's totaltime equals looptime, convert it to an infinite loop (totaltime = -1, looptime = 0).
returns: Name: Type: Description; anim: Anim\: nil: A new Anim userdata wrapping the preloaded animation, or nil if no matching animation exists.

name: animGetSpriteInfo
description: Get information about a sprite used by an animation.
parameters: 1: anim: Anim: Animation userdata.; 2: group: uint16: Optional. Explicit sprite group number.; 3: number: uint16: Optional. Explicit sprite number. These are only used when both group and number are provided; otherwise the animation's current sprite is used.
returns: Name: Type: Description; info: table\: nil: Table with:- Group (uint16) sprite group number- Number (uint16) sprite number- Size (uint16[2]) {width, height}- Offset (int16[2]) {x, y}- palidx (int) palette index used for this sprite,or nil if no sprite is available.

name: animLoadPalettes
description: Load palettes for an animation's underlying sprite file, if palette usage is enabled.
parameters: 1: anim: Anim: Animation userdata.; 2: param: int: Palette parameter passed to loadActPalettes (engine-specific semantics).

name: animNew
description: Create a new animation from a sprite file and action definition.
parameters: 1: sff: Sff: Optional. Sprite file userdata to use. If omitted or invalid, a new empty SFF is created internally.; 2: actOrAnim: string\: Animation: Either:- a string definition of the animation to load, or- an Animation userdata (for example from motif.AnimTable[...]).
returns: Name: Type: Description; anim: Anim: Newly created animation userdata.

name: animPaletteGet
description: Get a palette from an animation.
parameters: 1: anim: Anim: Animation userdata.; 2: paletteId: int: 1-based palette index.
returns: Name: Type: Description; palette: table: Array-like table where each entry is {r, g, b, a}.

name: animPaletteSet
description: Set colors in an animation palette.
parameters: 1: anim: Anim: Animation userdata.; 2: paletteId: int: 1-based palette index.; 3: palette: table: Array-like table where each entry is {r, g, b, a}.

name: animPrepare
description: Prepare an animation so that each character can apply its own palette.
parameters: 1: anim: Anim: Source animation userdata.; 2: charRef: int32: 0-based character index in the select list.
returns: Name: Type: Description; preparedAnim: Anim: Either a copy with adjusted palette data (when palette usage is enabled) or the original anim when palette handling is disabled.

name: animReset
description: Reset an animation to its initial state, fully or partially.
parameters: 1: anim: Anim: Animation userdata.; 2: parts: table: Optional.If omitted or nil, resets everything. If provided, must be an array-like table of strings, each one of:- "anim": reset the underlying Animation- "pos": reset position to the initial offset- "scale": reset scale to the initial values- "window": reset the clipping window to the initial value- "velocity": reset velocity to the initial value- "palfx": clear PalFX

name: animSetAccel
description: Set gravity/acceleration applied to an animation.
parameters: 1: anim: Anim: Animation userdata.; 2: ax: float32: Horizontal acceleration.; 3: ay: float32: Vertical acceleration.

name: animSetAlpha
description: Set alpha blending for an animation.
parameters: 1: anim: Anim: Animation userdata.; 2: src: int16: Source alpha factor (0–256, engine-specific).; 3: dst: int16: Destination alpha factor (0–256, engine-specific).

name: animSetAngle
description: Set rotation angle for an animation.
parameters: 1: anim: Anim: Animation userdata.; 2: angle: float32: Rotation angle.

name: animSetAnimation
description: Replace an animation's underlying Animation data.
parameters: 1: anim: Anim: Animation userdata to modify.; 2: actOrAnim: string\: Animation: Either:- a string definition of the animation to load, or- an Animation userdata (for example from motif.AnimTable[...]).

name: animSetColorKey
description: Set the color key (transparent index) used by an animation.
parameters: 1: anim: Anim: Animation userdata.; 2: index: int16: Palette index used as the transparency key.

name: animSetColorPalette
description: Change the active palette mapping for an animation.
parameters: 1: anim: Anim: Animation userdata.; 2: paletteId: int: 1-based palette identifier to map to.
returns: Name: Type: Description; anim: Anim: The same animation userdata (for chaining).

name: animSetFacing
description: Set the facing (horizontal flip) of an animation.
parameters: 1: anim: Anim: Animation userdata.; 2: facing: float32: Facing multiplier, usually 1 or -1.

name: animSetFocalLength
description: Set focal length used for perspective projection on an animation.
parameters: 1: anim: Anim: Animation userdata.; 2: fLength: float32: Focal length value.

name: animSetFriction
description: Set friction applied to an animation's velocity.
parameters: 1: anim: Anim: Animation userdata.; 2: fx: float32: Horizontal friction.; 3: fy: float32: Vertical friction.

name: animSetLayerno
description: Set the render layer used by an animation.
parameters: 1: anim: Anim: Animation userdata.; 2: layer: int16: Layer index to draw this animation on.

name: animSetLocalcoord
description: Set the local coordinate system for an animation.
parameters: 1: anim: Anim: Animation userdata.; 2: width: float32: Local coordinate width.; 3: height: float32: Local coordinate height.

name: animSetMaxDist
description: Set maximum drawing distance (clipping bounds) for an animation.
parameters: 1: anim: Anim: Animation userdata.; 2: maxX: float32: Maximum horizontal distance.; 3: maxY: float32: Maximum vertical distance.

name: animSetPalFX
description: Configure palette effects for an animation.
parameters: 1: anim: Anim: Animation userdata.; 2: palfx: table: Table of palette effect fields:- time (int32): duration in ticks- add (table int32[3]): additive RGB components- mul (table int32[3]): multiplicative RGB components- sinadd (table int32[4]): sinusoidal add {r, g, b, period}; negative period flips sign- sinmul (table int32[4]): sinusoidal mul {r, g, b, period}; negative period flips sign- sincolor (table int32[2]): sinusoidal color shift {amount, period}- sinhue (table int32[2]): sinusoidal hue shift {amount, period}- invertall (int32): set to 1 to invert all colors- invertblend (int32): invert blend mode index- color (float32): color saturation factor (0–256 scaled to 0.0–1.0)- hue (float32): hue adjustment factor (0–256 scaled to 0.0–0.5)

name: animSetPos
description: Set animation position, optionally overriding only one axis.
parameters: 1: anim: Anim: Animation userdata.; 2: x: float32: Optional. New X position; if omitted, initial X offset is used.; 3: y: float32: Optional. New Y position; if omitted, initial Y offset is used.

name: animSetProjection
description: Set projection mode for an animation.
parameters: 1: anim: Anim: Animation userdata.; 2: projection: int32\: string: Projection mode. Can be a numeric engine constant, or one of:- "orthographic"- "perspective"- "perspective2"

name: animSetScale
description: Set the scale of an animation.
parameters: 1: anim: Anim: Animation userdata.; 2: sx: float32: Horizontal scale factor.; 3: sy: float32: Vertical scale factor.

name: animSetTile
description: Configure tiling for an animation.
parameters: 1: anim: Anim: Animation userdata.; 2: tileX: boolean: If true, tile horizontally.; 3: tileY: boolean: If true, tile vertically.; 4: spacingX: int32: Optional. Horizontal tile spacing in pixels.; 5: spacingY: int32: Optional. Vertical tile spacing in pixels (defaults to spacingX if omitted).

name: animSetVelocity
description: Set the base velocity of an animation.
parameters: 1: anim: Anim: Animation userdata.; 2: vx: float32: Horizontal velocity.; 3: vy: float32: Vertical velocity.

name: animSetWindow
description: Set the clipping window for an animation.
parameters: 1: anim: Anim: Animation userdata.; 2: x1: float32: Left coordinate of the clipping window.; 3: y1: float32: Top coordinate of the clipping window.; 4: x2: float32: Right coordinate of the clipping window.; 5: y2: float32: Bottom coordinate of the clipping window.

name: animSetXAngle
description: Set rotation angle around the X axis for an animation.
parameters: 1: anim: Anim: Animation userdata.; 2: xangle: float32: X-axis rotation angle (engine-specific units, usually degrees).

name: animSetXShear
description: Set the X shear factor applied when drawing an animation.
parameters: 1: anim: Anim: Animation userdata.; 2: shear: float32: X shear factor.

name: animSetYAngle
description: Set rotation angle around the Y axis for an animation.
parameters: 1: anim: Anim: Animation userdata.; 2: yangle: float32: Y-axis rotation angle.

name: animUpdate
description: Advance an animation by one tick. By default, only the first call per frame advances the animation.
parameters: 1: anim: Anim: Animation userdata.; 2: force: boolean: Optional. Default: false. If true, advance the animation even if it was already updated this frame.

name: batchDraw
description: Queue drawing of many animations in one call.
parameters: 1: batch: table: Array-like table of draw items. Each item is a table:- anim (Anim) animation userdata- x (float32) X position- y (float32) Y position- facing (float32) facing multiplier (usually 1 or -1)- scale (table float32[2], optional) {sx, sy} scale override- xshear (float32, optional) X shear override- angle (float32, optional) rotation angle override- xangle (float32, optional) X-axis rotation override- yangle (float32, optional) Y-axis rotation override- projection (int32\: string, optional) projection override; accepts a numericengine constant or "orthographic", "perspective", "perspective2"- focallength (float32, optional) focal length override- layerno (int16, optional) layer override; defaults to anim.layerno

name: bgDebug
description: Print debug information about a background definition.
parameters: 1: bg: BGDef: Background definition userdata.; 2: prefix: string: Optional. Optional text prefix printed before the debug info.

name: bgDraw
description: Queue drawing of a background definition.
parameters: 1: bg: BGDef: Background definition userdata.; 2: layer: int32: Optional. Default: 0. 0 for back layer, 1 for front layer.; 3: x: float32: Optional. Default: 0. Global X offset applied when drawing.; 4: y: float32: Optional. Default: 0. Global Y offset applied when drawing.; 5: scale: float32: Optional. Default: 1.0. Uniform global scale multiplier.

name: bgNew
description: Load a background definition from a sprite file and configuration.
parameters: 1: sff: Sff: Sprite file userdata used by the background.; 2: defPath: string: Path used for resolving background resources.; 3: section: string: Name or identifier of the background definition to load.; 4: model: Model: Optional. Stage/model userdata associated with this background.; 5: defaultLayer: int32: Optional. Default: 0. Default layer index assigned to the background elements.
returns: Name: Type: Description; bg: BGDef: Loaded background definition userdata.

name: bgReset
description: Reset a background definition to its initial state.
parameters: 1: bg: BGDef: Background definition userdata.

name: changeAnim
description: [redirectable] Change the character's current animation.
parameters: 1: animNo: int32: Animation number to switch to.; 2: elem: int32: Optional. Optional animation element index to start from.; 3: ffx: boolean: Optional. Default: false. If true, use the "f" animation prefix (FFX animation).
returns: Name: Type: Description; success: boolean: true if the animation exists and was changed, false otherwise.

name: changeState
description: [redirectable] Change the character's current state or disable it.
parameters: 1: stateNo: int32: State number to switch to, or -1 to disable the character.
returns: Name: Type: Description; success: boolean: true if an existing state was entered, false otherwise. Passing -1 disables the character and returns false.

name: clear
description: Clear all characters' clipboard text buffers.

name: clearAllSound
description: Stop all currently playing sounds.

name: clearColor
description: Fill the screen with a solid color (with optional alpha).
parameters: 1: r: int32: Red component (0–255).; 2: g: int32: Green component (0–255).; 3: b: int32: Blue component (0–255).; 4: alpha: int32: Optional. Default: 255. Alpha value (0–255); 255 is fully opaque.

name: clearConsole
description: Clear text printed to the in-engine console.

name: clearSelected
description: Clear all current select-screen choices (characters, stages, music, game params).

name: commandAdd
signature: commandAdd(name, command, time, bufferTime, bufferHitpause, bufferPauseend, stepTime)
description: Register a UI command definition.
parameters: 1: name: string: Command name (used in triggers).; 2: command: string: Command string in engine input notation.; 3: time: int32: Optional. Command input time window in ticks.; 4: bufferTime: int32: Optional. Buffer time in ticks.; 5: bufferHitpause: boolean: Optional. Whether inputs are buffered during hitpause.; 6: bufferPauseend: boolean: Optional. Whether inputs are buffered during pause end.; 7: stepTime: int32: Optional. Step granularity in ticks.

name: commandBufReset
description: Reset command input buffers.
parameters: 1: playerNo: int: Optional. 1-based player/controller index. If omitted, all command buffers are reset.

name: commandDebug
description: Print debug information about a command list.
parameters: 1: playerNo: int: 1-based player/controller index.; 2: prefix: string: Optional. Optional text prefix printed before the debug info.

name: commandGetState
description: Query the current state of a named command.
parameters: 1: playerNo: int: 1-based player/controller index.; 2: name: string: Command name to query.
returns: Name: Type: Description; active: boolean: true if the command is currently active, false otherwise.

name: computeRanking
description: Compute and store ranking data for a mode, returning whether it was cleared.
parameters: 1: mode: string: Ranking mode identifier.
returns: Name: Type: Description; cleared: boolean: true if the run cleared the mode's requirements.; place: int32: Ranking position (1-based), or 0 if unranked / skipped / not visible.

name: connected
description: Check if the main menu network connection is established.
returns: Name: Type: Description; connected: boolean: true if connected to a netplay peer, false otherwise.

name: continued
description: Check whether the current run used a continue.
returns: Name: Type: Description; continued: boolean: true if the continue flag is set.

name: endMatch
description: Signal that the current match should end (using fight screen fade-out settings).

name: enterNetPlay
description: Enter netplay as client or host.
parameters: 1: host: string: Host address (IP or hostname). If an empty string, listen for an incoming connection; otherwise connect to the given host.

name: enterReplay
description: Enter replay playback mode from a replay file.
parameters: 1: path: string: Path to the replay file.
returns: Name: Type: Description; success: boolean: true if the replay file was opened and playback started, false otherwise.

name: esc
description: Get or set the global escape flag.
parameters: 1: value: boolean: Optional. If provided, sets the escape flag.
returns: Name: Type: Description; esc: boolean: Current value of the escape flag.

name: exitNetPlay
description: Exit netplay mode and close any active netplay connection.

name: exitReplay
description: Exit replay mode and restore normal video settings.

name: fadeActive
description: Check whether any global motif fade is active.
returns: Name: Type: Description; active: boolean: true if fade-in or fade-out is currently running.

name: fadeInInit
description: Initialize a Fade object using motif fade-in settings.
parameters: 1: fade: Fade: Fade userdata to initialize.

name: fadeNew
description: Instantiates a Fade userdata for use with fadeInInit and fadeOutInit.
parameters: 1: params: table: Optional.Parameter table (keys are case-insenstive) :- time (int, opt) Duration in ticks- color (int[3], opt) RGB values (0–255)- anim (Anim, opt) Animation to play in the fade. If nil or invalid, will play no animation- sound (int[2], opt) Sound to play in the fade. Uses motif SND.
returns: Name: Type: Description; fade: Fade: Fade userdata.

name: fadeOutInit
description: Initialize a Fade object using motif fade-out settings.
parameters: 1: fade: Fade: Fade userdata to initialize.

name: fadeSkip
description: Immediately stop any running global motif fade.

name: fileExists
description: Test whether a file exists, after engine path resolution.
parameters: 1: path: string: File path to test (relative or absolute).
returns: Name: Type: Description; exists: boolean: true if the file exists, false otherwise.

name: findEntityByName
description: Find the next entity whose name contains the given text.
parameters: 1: text: string: Case-insensitive substring to search in entity names.

name: findEntityByPlayerId
description: Find the next entity with the given player ID.
parameters: 1: playerId: int32: Target entity id to search for.

name: findHelperById
description: Find the next helper with the given helper ID.
parameters: 1: helperId: int32: Target helper helperId to search for.

name: fontGetDef
description: Get basic font definition information.
parameters: 1: font: Fnt: Font userdata.
returns: Name: Type: Description; def: table: A table:- Type (string) font type identifier- Size (uint16[2]) {width, height} in pixels- Spacing (int32[2]) {x, y} spacing in pixels- offset (int32[2]) {x, y} base drawing offset

name: fontNew
description: Load a font from file.
parameters: 1: filename: string: Font filename (searched in font/, motif folder, current dir, data/).; 2: height: int32: Optional. Default: -1. Override font height; -1 uses the height defined in the font file.
returns: Name: Type: Description; font: Fnt: Loaded font userdata. If loading fails, a fallback font is returned.

name: frameStep
description: Enable single-frame stepping mode.

name: game
description: Execute a full match using the current configuration.
returns: Name: Type: Description; winSide: int32: Winning side index (1 or 2), 0 for draw, -1 if the game was ended externally.; controllerNo: int: 1-based controller index of the challenger player interrupting arcade mode.

name: game.challenger
description: Called from the second frame onward on the challenger screen.
parameters: none
returns: bool. Returns false if further Lua script execution should stop, based on the function parameters and match result. Otherwise returns true.

name: game.challengerinit
description: Called on the first frame of the challenger screen.

name: game.continue
description: Called from the second frame onward on the continue screen.

name: game.continueinit
description: Called on the first frame of the continue screen.

name: game.hiscore
description: Called from the second frame onward on the hiscore screen.

name: game.hiscoreinit
description: Called on the first frame of the hiscore screen.

name: game.result
description: Called from the second frame onward on the win / results screen.

name: game.resultinit
description: Called on the first frame of the win / results screen.

name: game.victory
description: Called from the second frame onward on the victory screen.

name: game.victoryinit
description: Called on the first frame of the victory screen.

name: gameRunning
description: Check whether a match is currently running.
returns: Name: Type: Description; running: boolean: true if gameplay is currently active.

name: getAnimElemCount
description: [redirectable] Get the character's number of elements in the animation.
returns: Name: Type: Description; count: int: Number of animation elements.

name: getAnimTimeSum
description: [redirectable] Get the character's current accumulated time of the animation.
returns: Name: Type: Description; timeSum: int32: Current animation time value.

name: getCharAttachedInfo
description: Resolve and read basic information from a character definition file.
parameters: 1: def: string: Character identifier or .def path. If no extension is given, "chars//.def" is assumed.
returns: Name: Type: Description; info: table\: nil: A table:- name (string) character display name (or internal name as fallback)- def (string) resolved .def path- sound (string) sound file path from the [Files] section,or nil if the .def file cannot be resolved.

name: getCharFileName
description: Get the definition file path for a character slot.
parameters: 1: charRef: int: 0-based character index in the select list.
returns: Name: Type: Description; defPath: string: Resolved .def path for this slot.

name: getCharInfo
description: Get detailed information about a character slot.
parameters: 1: charRef: int: 0-based character index in the select list.
returns: Name: Type: Description; info: table: A table:- name (string) character display name- author (string) author string- def (string) definition file path- sound (string) sound file path- intro (string) intro def path- ending (string) ending def path- arcadepath (string) arcade path override- localcoord (float32) base localcoord width- portraitscale (float32) scale applied to portraits- cnsscale (float32[]) scale values from the CNS configuration- pal (int32[]) available palette numbers (at least {1})- paldefaults (int32[]) default palette numbers (at least {1})- palkeymap (table) palette key remaps, indexed by original palette slot

name: getCharName
description: Get the display name of a character slot.
parameters: 1: charRef: int: 0-based character index in the select list.
returns: Name: Type: Description; name: string: Character display name.

name: getCharPreloadStatus
description: Query the background preload state of a character slot.
parameters: 1: charRef: int: 0-based character index in the select list.
returns: Name: Type: Description; state: string: Preload state: "idle", "queued", "loading", or "ready".

name: getCharRandomPalette
description: Get a random valid palette number for a character slot.
parameters: 1: charRef: int: 0-based character index in the select list.
returns: Name: Type: Description; palNo: int32: Palette number; defaults to 1 if the character has no palette list.

name: getCharSelectParams
description: Get parsed select parameters for a character entry.
parameters: 1: charRef: int: 0-based character index in the select list.
returns: Name: Type: Description; params: table: Lua table created from the comma-separated params string passed to addChar().

name: getClipboardString
description: Get the current system clipboard string.
returns: Name: Type: Description; text: string: Clipboard contents, or an empty string if unavailable.

name: getCommandLineFlags
description: Get all command-line flags passed to the engine.
returns: Name: Type: Description; flags: table: A table mapping raw flag keys to their values (string).

name: getCommandLineValue
description: Get the value of a specific command-line flag.
parameters: 1: flagName: string: Exact flag key as stored in sys.cmdFlags
returns: Name: Type: Description; value: string\: nil: Value associated with the flag, or nil if the flag is not present.

name: getConsecutiveWins
description: Get the number of consecutive wins for a team.
parameters: 1: teamSide: int: Team side (1 or 2).
returns: Name: Type: Description; wins: int32: Number of consecutive wins for the given side.

name: getCredits
description: Get the current credit count.
returns: Name: Type: Description; credits: int32: Current number of credits.

name: getDirectoryFiles
description: Recursively list all paths under a directory.
parameters: 1: rootPath: string: Starting directory path.
returns: Name: Type: Description; paths: table: Array-like table of visited paths (files and directories).

name: getFrameCount
description: Get the global frame counter value.
returns: Name: Type: Description; frameCount: int32: Number of frames elapsed since engine start.

name: getGameFPS
description: Get the current measured gameplay FPS.
returns: Name: Type: Description; fps: float32: Current gameplay frames per second.

name: getGameParams
description: Get the current game parameter table.
returns: Name: Type: Description; params: table: Current game parameters as a Lua table.

name: getGameSpeed
description: Get the current game logic speed as a percentage.
returns: Name: Type: Description; speedPercent: int32: Integer game logic speed relative to 60 FPS (100 = normal speed).

name: getGameStats
description: Read accumulated game statistics.
returns: Name: Type: Description; stats: table: Statistics log object as a Lua table.

name: getGameStatsJson
description: Get a JSON snapshot of accumulated game statistics.
returns: Name: Type: Description; json: string: JSON-encoded snapshot containing stats and related flags.

name: getInput
description: Check raw UI input for one or more players.
parameters: 1: players: number\: table: 1-based player/controller index, or an array-like table of indexes. Passing -1 checks all players.; 2: ...: string\: table: One or more key/button tokens, or array-like tables of tokens.
returns: Name: Type: Description; pressed: boolean: true if any provided token set is active for any selected player.

name: getInputTime
description: Get the hold time of a raw input token for one or more players.
parameters: 1: players: number\: table: 1-based player/controller index, or an array-like table of indexes. Passing -1 checks all players.; 2: ...: string\: table: One or more key/button tokens, or array-like tables of tokens.
returns: Name: Type: Description; time: int32: Hold time in ticks for the first active token found, or 0 if none are active.

name: getJoystickGUID
description: Get a joystick's GUID string.
parameters: 1: index: int: Joystick index (0-based).
returns: Name: Type: Description; guid: string: GUID string for the joystick, or an empty string if invalid.

name: getJoystickKey
description: Poll joystick input and return the corresponding key string.
parameters: 1: controllerIdx: int: Optional. Joystick index (0-based). If omitted, listens on any joystick.
returns: Name: Type: Description; keyName: string: Engine key string for the pressed control (empty string if none).; joystickIndex: int: 1-based joystick index that generated the input; -1 if no input.

name: getJoystickName
